To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the SLC linacs, damping rings, and positron source are capable of injecting a 1658-bunch, 1.5 A electron beam and a 1658 bunch, 2.1A positron beam into the PEP tunnel with a fill time of less than an hour.

the SLC injection system is capable of providing 1658 bunch pairs of electrons and positrons with the required low emittance at the rate of about one pair every 2.5 s, and that the SLC damping rings are capable of providing the necessary cooling.

(1) the SLC damping rings and positrons source are ideally suited to the task of providing a profuse source of electron and positron beams to the proposed asymmetric energy B Factory, (2) with some simple modifications to the SLC linacs, the injection system can provide the required beam parameters, (3) the injection system will be able to fill the two rings in a small part of an hour.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design, fabrication and testing of a high current electron source for a high luminosity B factory.
the development of an asymmetric B Factory in the PEP Tunnel.
the design and development of a high-intensity, high-quality, low-emittance source of positron bunches for injection into the asymmetric B factory in PEP.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the PEP tunnel is ideally suited for the construction of an asymmetric energy B factory.
the SLC linca with its damping rings, and positron source, is an ideal injector for the proposed B factory.
a very effective injection system can be designed and constructed to provide an asymmetric B factory at PEP with a luminosity in the 10{sup 34} cm{sup -2}s{sup -1} range.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown that the SLC linacs can be used to produce 1.5 A of low-emittance electrons and 1.0 A of low-emistence positrons.
the SLC linacs and damping rings are ideally suited for use in the B factory.
the SLC injector is capable of providing the required number of bunches and the required bunch parameters for the B factory.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the SLC linacs can serve as an effective injector for an asymmetric energy B factory.
the SLC injector is well suited for use as a B factory injector.
the SLC injector can be modified to provide a high-quality injection for the B Factory.
